surgery.note: 脱水・低 K 血症予防のため当日朝休薬。心不全の治療で使っている場合は継続し、手術の前から用量を調整して体液量を整える (ESC 2022)。

surgery.source_title: 2024 AHA/ACC/ACS/ASNC/HRS/SCA/SCCT/SCMR/SVM Guideline for Perioperative Cardiovascular Management for Noncardiac Surgery
surgery.quote_excerpt:
BP Rec 1 (2a, C-EO): "In most* patients with HTN planned for elective NCS, it is reasonable to continue medical therapy
for HTN throughout the perioperative period.†"
HF Rec 2 (2a, C-LD): "In patients with compensated HF undergoing NCS, it is reasonable to continue GDMT
(excluding SGLT2i) in the perioperative period, unless contraindicated, to reduce the risk of worsening HF."
surgery.source_location: p.40 Preoperative Blood Pressure Management Rec 1 + p.42 HF Rec 2 (MRA は HFrEF の GDMT)

surgery.source_title: 2022 ESC Guidelines on cardiovascular assessment and management of patients undergoing non-cardiac surgery
surgery.quote_excerpt:
"For patients on diuretics to treat hypertension, transient discontinuation of diuretics on the day of NCS
should be considered." (Class IIa, LoE B)
"In general, therapy for treatment of hypertension should be continued to the day of surgery and resumed orally
when possible. However, the benefit for continuing diuretics as antihypertensive therapy is unclear."
"In HF, the dosage of diuretics should be adjusted well in advance for an optimal fluid balance before surgery,
and to avoid fluid retention or dehydration." …

2022 ESC Guidelines on cardiovascular assessment and management of patients undergoing non-cardiac surgery
references.quote_excerpt: For patients on diuretics to treat hypertension, transient discontinuation of diuretics on the day of NCS should be considered. (Class IIa, Level of Evidence B) ... Therapy for treatment of hypertension should be continued to the day of surgery and resumed orally when possible. The possibility of electrolyte disturbance should be considered in any patient receiving diuretics. Hypokalaemia is reported to occur in up to 36% of patients undergoing surgery (mostly NCS). Any electrolyte disturbance, especially hypokalaemia and hypomagnesaemia, should be corrected in due time before surgery.
references.quote_translation_excerpt: 高血圧治療目的の利尿薬服用患者では、非心臓手術当日 (day of NCS) の一時中止を考慮すべき (Class IIa、エビデンス B)。高血圧治療は手術当日まで継続し、可能な限り速やかに経口再開。利尿薬服用患者では電解質異常 (特に低 K 血症は最大 36%) に注意し術前に補正
references.location_in_source: p.3856 Section 5.2.7 Diuretics + p.3857 Recommendation Table 12
